title: Three Years and One Short Bell
subtitle: 学校教育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）
meta: 主题语境：学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）　|　核心词汇：pen　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 pen 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1989 the headmaster ① held the pen that no student in the school would have counted, and he said the holding was the whole of the year. The ② pen, meaning the instrument itself and not the bell, ran three years and stayed uncounted in the book; a pen, he said, is the only thing in a school that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ pen in that school had the same short bell beside it, and the ④ pen at the far gate, meaning the prize they kept for the children to win and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A pen, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the headmaster said the counting is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the pen was the whole of the matter, meaning the voice and not the instrument. The ⑥ pen, meaning the voice and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; pen, he said, is either something you hold or the only word that means both an instrument and a voice. He said the voice is the part they remember.

By 1994 the ⑦ pen had become a line in a record, and the record had become an argument about the short bell. The ⑧ pen of the whole thing, the headmaster wrote in October, was one school and three years of counting; pen, he said, is either the prize at the far gate or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ pen I remember is the instrument counted in the record, which closed in 1996 and is still counted as the quietest in the school. A ⑩ pen, my mother said in 1998, is the only instrument that improves by being counted; every pen, she said, is a voice that has agreed to look like an instrument. She said the voice was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 钢笔（指学堂里每一支旁边的那一支）
B. n. 钢笔（指那支钢笔本身，与小小的铜铃相对）
C. 固定搭配：hold the pen 握这一支钢笔
D. n. 钢笔（指留给孩子们争的那一份）
E. n. 钢笔之事（抽象总称，指一处学堂的钢笔之事）
F. n. 钢笔（指学籍册里写到、被清点的那一支）
G. n. 钢笔、心声（指一件事里人人都守却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 心声（抽象总称，指人人都守却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: held the pen that no student in the school would have counted
The pen, meaning the instrument itself and not the bell
the pen at the far gate
the pen was the whole of the matter

answers.why: hold the pen 意为“握这一支钢笔”，1989 年那位校长把学堂里没有一位学生肯清点的一支钢笔做了一遍。
pen 意为“钢笔”，指那支钢笔本身而不是小小的铜铃，它经过了三个学年而在簿子上没有被清点。
pen 意为“钢笔”，指学堂里每一支旁边的那一支，每一支旁边都有同一只小小的铜铃。
pen 意为“钢笔”，指最远那道校门的留给孩子们争的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
pen 意为“钢笔、心声”，指一件事里人人都守却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这支心声就是那件事的全部。
pen 意为“心声”，指人人都守却无人提起的那样东西而不是那支钢笔，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
pen 意为“钢笔”，指学籍册里写到、被清点的那一支，到 1994 年这一支成了学籍册里的一行。
pen 意为“钢笔之事”，校长十月写道，整件事的钢笔之事是一处学堂和三个学年的清点。
pen 意为“钢笔”，我记得的是学籍册里清点过的那一支，1996 年办完了，至今仍被说成学堂里最安静的一支。
pen 为抽象总称，母亲 1998 年说，钢笔是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的钢笔。
